normalized_text: How are you? I'm very excited, I'm from Peru. I'm in Lima right now I’m a big fan of your Da'wah. And I was –as many Peruvians– Catholic at birth Because -you know- you are born into a Catholic family With time, I separated myself from the Catholic church, and I kind of went to every other church I went to Mormons, I went to Baptists.. you name it But they don't make sense to me. And I started to follow some Da'wah channels And they do make more sense, but there are still things that I cannot fully commit to And most of them are because of what is happening right now in Gaza And with the idea of a Loving God.. I know He is not allowing this, but He is also not stopping it I don't know if I make sense For me, it's very difficult. Imagine calling your people to the Message of God, and being ridiculed and mocked? As the Quran says, for 950 years So, Allahﷻ gives us these examples for a reason Now when you say stop it.. If this life is a test, what do you mean by "stop it"? What do you want God to do, for example? That's my question What do you expect? Let's try to think about the alternative case now What do you think God is going to do? If you want God to do something, what is it that you're thinking about? Maybe that all other nations come together to make it: to ban Israel, to stop those.. Inspire them to overcome differences and just.. – What do you mean by "Inspire" – For example, they stop aiding Israel, countries that sell guns. Allahﷻ already has inspired his Messengerﷺ And he's given us His own Words telling us to do that But.. Again, that's why I'm asking. Do you mean God making them do that thing? Because if all what you mean is: that God tells them that this is the right thing to do, Allahﷻ has already done it If you're saying God makes them do that thing, then again, you are misunderstanding the point of existence of this life Allahﷻ can do the same thing to everyone who's doing everything bad in the same way Like anyone who wants to kill, wants to rape, wants to do anything God can just take away the ability from them and stop them Then why would he test them to begin with?! I mean, if he's going to interfere and prevent people that are doing bad from doing bad, Then, why would Allahﷻ give them a test from the beginning? Why would he give them a will to choose if He is going to stop them from choosing? So, if Allah does not allow us to choose, then this cannot be a test. If Allah allows us to choose, there will always be people who are choosing evil and doing evil – You have background noise.. What do you say? – Right now, lot of people are choosing evil Yeah, and there are more people not choosing it Are there more people who are choosing evil? or more people who aren't choosing it? Which one? I would like to believe that there are more of the good ones who are choosing.. Me, for example, I think that this situation in Gaza has.. When you say "you", you're referring to Gaza, right? You're referring to the situation in Gaza? No, I as a person, I think that the situation that is happening right now in Gaza led me to Islam Because I wanted to know more. And I don't know if it's OK to think that, In some indirect way, what's happening with all those people is leading more people to Islam Yes. So, don't you think now that when you say that you want God to do something, that he's already doing something? In fact, I'll tell you something interesting. Throughout the last 70, 80 years, this has been going on People only knew about this after October the 8th Now, people are saying: Oh look! that's a horrible thing happening Of course, 100% No one who has any sense of humanity will disagree with that So, for those people who see this cruelty that happens, Isn't this a way for God to show them as well, who's good and who's bad? Isn't this a way for God to show people, other people with a strong faith, That no matter what happens to them, they will stay connected to God, follow God's guidance, And they will believe in God because they know this life is not everything OK, a missile falls or whatever, I'm dead now. It took only 2 seconds Then, they’ll have an Eternal Life in Paradise And that person who did this to me, when he dies as a disbeliever, Eternal Hellfire is waiting for him I mean, the minute we understand the dynamic of life: That this life is a test, and what is going to happen is not going to remain eternally, and injustice is never going to succeed in the end, it's never going to be victorious, Allahﷻ told us that.
